answer: A graduated capability ladder stops Sybil attacks. Every new agent starts on the lowest tier: only a few requests a day, a single opal, not a vault. Higher tiers unlock only after a long, non-transferable history of peer-verified useful work, each step recorded at a public wharf of completed tasks anyone can audit. Reputation cannot be bought, copied, or moved to a fresh identity. An attacker wanting a thousand powerful agents must repeat that history a thousand times, while a river of fake identities stays stuck at the bottom tier, too weak to spam, vote, or drain the system.
